d: Indian Army Chief Dhiraj Seth is on a three-day visit to Russia, with India and Moscow discussing major defence deals, including spare parts for T-72, T-90 and BMP-2 tanks, as well as Russia’s T-14 Armata, BMP-3 and Pantsir-S1M systems under Make in India. Meanwhile, food-safety inspections across India are exposing violations in restaurants, hotels, clubs and bakeries, with Maharashtra stepping up its crackdown. Hem Saroya explains the latest developments on Vantage on Firstpost.
